title: Best The Gutter Guys Alternatives in 2026: Ranked
body_markdown:
The Gutter Guys built a name doing what most local gutter outfits do well: routine cleanings, spot repairs, and basic screen-style guards installed by a rotating crew. That's a real service and it solves a real problem for years. The ceiling shows up the moment a homeowner wants a permanent fix — true micro-mesh that stops pine needles and oak debris, a warranty that transfers with the house, or lighting bundled into the same truck roll. **The best The Gutter Guys alternative in 2026 is CleanGutters Lighting if you're in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware and want owner-installed micro-mesh with a transferable lifetime warranty; LeafFilter if you're outside that footprint and want a nationally recognized brand; DIY if your home is single-story and you'd rather spend time than money.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins on owner-installed stainless steel micro-mesh with a transferable lifetime warranty in South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware.
- The Gutter Guys covers routine cleaning and basic guards well but hits its ceiling on permanent debris protection.
- LeafFilter is the strongest the gutter guys alternatives pick if you live outside the South Jersey/Eastern PA/Northern Delaware service area.
- DIY gutter cleaning works for single-story homes with light tree cover but comes with zero warranty backing.
- Homeowners bundling gutter protection with permanent roofline lighting cut down to one contractor instead of two.




## Why this matters

A gutter service decision made in 2026 sticks around for a decade or more once guards go up. Picking wrong means paying for a service call twice — once for the install, once for the redo. The gap between "gutter service" and "gutter protection system" is the whole story here.

Routine cleaning crews like The Gutter Guys solve today's clog. Micro-mesh systems solve the next ten years of clogs. Knowing which one you actually need before you sign anything saves real money.

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for owner-installed micro-mesh protection

CleanGutters Lighting has served South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware since 2009, and the core product is surgical stainless steel micro-mesh backed by a transferable lifetime warranty. Every install is done by the owner directly, not handed off to a sub-crew, which is the opposite of how most regional gutter companies staff jobs in 2026. The company also runs custom architectural roofline LED lighting, so the same visit that solves gutters can solve holiday and permanent lighting too.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**
- Stainless steel micro-mesh built to keep out pine needles, shingle grit, and small debris that screen guards let through
- Transferable lifetime warranty that follows the house to the next owner
- Owner-installed craftsmanship on every job, not subcontracted labor
- Permanent roofline lighting bundled with gutter work under one contractor

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**
- Service footprint is limited to South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware, so it's not an option outside that area
- No big-box retail presence or nationwide brand recognition the way a franchise name carries

**Best for:** homeowners inside the South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware footprint who want one accountable installer instead of a rotating crew.

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | The Gutter Guys |
|---|---|---|

| Warranty | Transferable lifetime | Varies by job |

## 2. LeafFilter: best for national brand recognition

LeafFilter is a widely advertised national micro-mesh brand with dealers and installers across most of the country. If you're outside the South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware service area, it's the most recognizable name in the [gutter guard brand comparison](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/gutter-guard-brands-compared) category for 2026.

**Where LeafFilter shines:**
- National footprint means availability well beyond any single region
- Micro-mesh product line with heavy marketing awareness
- Established sales and install process homeowners can find reviews on

**Where LeafFilter falls short:**
- Install quality depends on the local dealer or franchise crew assigned to the job, not one consistent installer
- Sales process is known for a hard-pitch, in-home consultation model
- No lighting bundle option

**Best for:** homeowners outside the CleanGutters Lighting footprint who still want a micro-mesh product from a name they've seen advertised.

## 3. DIY gutter cleaning and guards: best for single-story, budget-first homes

Doing it yourself is a real alternative for a single-story home with light tree cover and an owner willing to get on a ladder twice a year. Off-the-shelf screen guards and foam inserts cost less upfront than any professional install in 2026.

**Where DIY shines:**
- Lowest upfront cash outlay of any option on this list
- Full control over timing — clean it whenever it's convenient

**Where DIY falls short:**
- No warranty backing anything you install
- Ladder work carries real fall risk on two-story homes
- Store-bought screens and foam clog faster than surgical micro-mesh and need re-cleaning multiple times a season

**Best for:** single-story homeowners with minimal tree cover and the time to maintain gutters seasonally.

## Why people switch from The Gutter Guys

The pattern shows up the same way across South Jersey and Eastern PA in 2026: homeowners start with routine cleaning, then hit a season where oak acorns or pine needles overwhelm a basic screen guard faster than expected. At that point the choice is a second service call for cleaning or a one-time switch to true micro-mesh.

The other driver is accountability. A subcontracted crew rotation means the person who shows up in 2026 might not be the same person who installed the system in 2023. Homeowners who want one name attached to the whole job tend to move toward an owner-installed model.

## When The Gutter Guys is still the right call

If your home just needs a seasonal cleaning and you're not ready to invest in a permanent guard system, sticking with a routine cleaning service like The Gutter Guys is the honest answer. Not every home needs micro-mesh in 2026 — a low tree-cover property with a tight budget can get by on cleaning alone for years.

## FAQ


**What is the best The Gutter Guys alternative in 2026?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the strongest pick inside South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware for owner-installed micro-mesh with a transferable lifetime warranty. Outside that footprint, LeafFilter is the more available national option.

**Is micro-mesh better than the screen guards The Gutter Guys installs?**

Surgical stainless steel micro-mesh blocks smaller debris like pine needles and shingle grit that standard screen guards let through. Screen guards are cheaper but need more frequent maintenance.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting offer more than gutter guards?**

Yes — the company also installs custom architectural roofline LED lighting alongside gutter cleaning, repair, and micro-mesh protection. Both services can be scheduled under one contractor visit.

**Is DIY gutter cleaning a real alternative to a service company?**

It works for single-story homes with light tree cover and an owner willing to climb a ladder a few times a year. It carries no warranty and higher fall risk on two-story homes.

**How is LeafFilter different from a local gutter company?**

LeafFilter operates through local dealers and franchise crews nationwide, while a local company like CleanGutters Lighting has the owner install every job personally. Install consistency depends on which model you value more.

**Does a transferable warranty matter when selling a house?**

Yes — a transferable lifetime warranty on gutter guards adds a documented selling point for the next buyer. Warranties that don't transfer lose their value the moment the house changes hands.

**What areas does CleanGutters Lighting serve?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware as of 2026. Homeowners outside that area need a different alternative like LeafFilter.


## One last thing

The detail most homeowners miss when comparing The Gutter Guys alternatives in 2026: bundling gutter protection with permanent roofline lighting under one owner-installed contractor cuts a second truck roll entirely. That's not a feature most cleaning-focused companies or national franchises offer side by side.
